name: Combined Depth Cueing and Shading (Reversed Order)
aliases: Reversed order shading and depth cueing
definition: A technique to combine depth cueing and directional shading by reversing the order of operations (shading first, then depth cueing) to use a single composite filter H' and avoid two convolutions.
summary: Combined Depth Cueing and Shading (Reversed Order) is a frequency-domain technique that applies depth cueing before shading using a composite filter to reduce computational cost, correcting errors with an adjustment term when the light vector is not perpendicular to the view vector.
